setup_fastcsp_logger: create a FastCSP logger with configurable file and console handlers for centralized logging
print_fastcsp_header: print the FastCSP project header with developer info and key features to the logger
log_config_pretty: log a configuration dictionary as pretty-printed JSON to the FastCSP logger
log_stage_start: log the start of a FastCSP workflow stage with an optional description message
log_error: log an error with its type and full traceback to the FastCSP logger
